shortDescription: SharePoint Framework (SPFx) Adaptive Card Extensions (ACEs) for Microsoft Viva Connections that use the basic card and image card templates, QuickViews, and the Viva Connections geolocation actions.
longDescription: SharePoint Framework (SPFx) Adaptive Card Extensions (ACEs) for Microsoft Viva Connections that use the basic card and image card templates, QuickViews, and the Viva Connections geolocation actions.
